exercises.title: Verify chown/chgrp outcome and least privilege
exercises.instructions: Author-only, disposable administrator sandbox. Create /workspace/qa-ownership/team.txt, change its owner and group inside the container to UID 1000 and GID 1000, and restrict its mode to 0640. Use `id`, `ls -l`, and `stat` to inspect. The verifier checks UID, GID, and mode from an independent read-only sidecar; it does not trust your terminal transcript. Do not create or modify system users or host directories.
